components.name: ArticleCard
components.description: Article or place card (History & Madinah). Code: shadcn <Card> wrapped in a <Link>. showImage = optional photo or illustration: put an image fill on "Image" (object-cover, rounded-2xl). meta = era or place.

excerpt.default: About 700 Muslims faced 3,000 fighters of Quraysh below the mountain the Prophet loved. Allah speaks of it in Sūrah Āl ‘Imrān.

kids.n: About 700 Muslims faced 3,000 fighters of Quraysh below the mountain the Prophet loved. Allah speaks of it in Sūrah Āl ‘Imrān.

text.value: About 700 Muslims faced 3,000 fighters of Quraysh below the mountain the Prophet loved. Allah speaks of it in Sūrah Āl ‘Imrān.

components.name: AudioPlayer
components.description: Recitation player. state = default · playing. Code: custom <AudioPlayer src label>.

components.name: Badge
components.description: shadcn <Badge variant>. Extra variants: highlight (gold), success (green).

components.name: BottomNav
components.description: Tab bar. active = current section. Includes the safe-area bottom padding. Code: custom <BottomNav active>.

components.name: Button
components.description: shadcn <Button variant size disabled>. Label = children. Icon = lucide icon placed after the label.

components.name: Callout
components.description: Short note inside a card. tone = info · highlight · success. Code: shadcn <Alert> styled per tone.

components.name: ChecklistItem
components.description: Do / avoid rule with a check or cross icon.

components.name: DuaBlock
components.description: Arabic text with transliteration, translation and optional source. Used in every duʿā card.

components.name: DuaCard
components.description: A duʿā with category, title, Arabic, transliteration, translation, audio, "when to recite" note and source. Reused in Duas and Favourites.

components.name: Emblem
components.description: Original 8-fold geometric rosette. Colour = brand token. Resize with the Scale tool (K). Code: export as SVG and use as a React component with stroke="currentColor".

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Empty screen or empty search result. Edit the nested buttons’ labels per use.

components.name: FactTile
components.description: One fact: label, value, caption. Two per row, 12px apart. Code: <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"> of rounded-2xl bg-muted p-4 tiles.

components.name: FaqItem
components.description: FAQ question with answer. shadcn <AccordionItem>: question = <AccordionTrigger> (chevron rotates 180° when open), answer + source = <AccordionContent>. showDivider off on the last item of a group.

question.default: Can I put on Ihrām at home or on the plane?

answer.default: Yes, you can wear the Iḥrām clothes before you travel. What matters is the intention: make it, with the Talbiyah, at the mīqāt or before it. On a plane, make it when the crew announces you are passing the mīqāt. Crossing the mīqāt without Iḥrām means going back to it; if you can’t, most scholars say a sacrifice (dam) is due.

components.name: FilterChip
components.description: Category filter. shadcn <ToggleGroupItem> styled as a pill. selected = active filter.

components.name: HomeIndicator
components.description: Device home indicator placeholder. In code: safe-area-inset-bottom.

components.name: InfoItem
components.description: A "What to know" point: icon, bold lead and explanation.

components.name: LegendItem
components.description: Explains a numbered marker on an illustration. The same number is placed on the drawing (Marker).

components.name: OptionCard
components.description: A selectable card (one choice from a list). Code: a shadcn <RadioGroupItem> wrapped in a <Label> styled as a card. Used for language and intent selection.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Stage progress bar. completed = number of stages done (0–7). Code: shadcn <Progress value={completed / 7 * 100} />.

components.name: QuizFeedback
components.description: Shown after answering. Friendly on wrong answers; the correct option is highlighted and the journey continues.

components.name: QuizOption
components.description: Knowledge-check answer. state = default · correct (picked, right) · wrong (picked, wrong) · answer (the right one, shown after a wrong pick). Never blocks progress.

components.name: QuoteCard
components.description: Qurʾān or ḥadīth pull-quote with its source. Code: , bg-highlight-muted rounded-2xl p-5.

quote.default: “Uhud is a mountain that loves us, and we love it.”

kids.n: “Uhud is a mountain that loves us, and we love it.”

text.value: “Uhud is a mountain that loves us, and we love it.”

components.name: RadioIndicator
components.description: shadcn <RadioGroupItem>. checked = selected state.

components.name: RelatedLink
components.description: Link to a related article or place. Code: <Link> row with lucide <MapPin /> and <ChevronRight />, bg-secondary rounded-2xl px-4 py-3.

description.default: The first mosque the Prophet built, on his arrival from Makkah

kids.n: The first mosque the Prophet built, on his arrival from Makkah

text.value: The first mosque the Prophet built, on his arrival from Makkah

components.name: RevealCard
components.description: Tap-to-reveal answer. state = hidden · revealed. Code: shadcn <Collapsible> styled as a card.

components.name: SavedItemCard
components.description: A saved item. kind = dua (Arabic + translation) · guide (stage excerpt) · faq (answer excerpt). Code: custom <SavedItemCard kind>.

components.name: SearchField
components.description: shadcn <Input> with a leading search icon, pill shaped. Reused on Duas, History, Madinah and FAQs.

components.name: SettingsRow
components.description: One settings row. value = label + current value + chevron (opens a sheet) · toggle = label + description + Switch · action = destructive label (opens a confirm sheet). Whole row is the tap target (≥ 52px).

components.name: SheetOption
components.description: One choice inside a bottom sheet. selected = check on the right. Tapping it selects and closes the sheet.

components.name: StageNode
components.description: A stage on the Learning Path roadmap. state = completed · current · upcoming.

components.name: StatusBar
components.description: Device status bar placeholder. In code this is the safe-area-inset-top, not a component.

components.name: StepItem
components.description: Numbered step or range (e.g. "1–3"). tone = primary · secondary. Number matches the Marker on an illustration.

components.name: Switch
components.description: shadcn <Switch checked>. Place at the end of a settings row; make the whole row the tap target (min 44px tall).

components.name: TabsTrigger
components.description: shadcn <TabsTrigger>. Place 2+ inside a TabsList frame (muted fill, radius full, 4px padding).

components.name: TopBar
components.description: App bar. root = tab screens (leading icon + action), detail = pushed screens (back button). Code: custom <TopBar>.
